'''October 2001 Carmel tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Downtown Comics, Carmel, Indiana on 6 October 2001. [[Jeremy Salinas]] won it. It is known from Eric Bailey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3022">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-06-carmel-in-10-06-01d3022/ carmel-in-10-06-01], DeckTech (Eric "YOYOY" Bailey, 6 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-06-carmel-in-10-06-01d3022/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 6 October 2001
* '''Site:''' Downtown Comics, Carmel, Indiana
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Jeremy Salinas]]
